name: agent-transcript
tagline_zh: 把 GitHub 讨论区的 AI 对话一键脱敏，预览后再插入 PR/issue。不怕泄露内部链接，还能保留原味语气。
tagline_en: Redact AI chat from GitHub threads, preview before inserting into PRs/issues. Keep tone, drop leaks.
desc_en: GitHub PR/issue agent transcripts: redact, preview, and insert safely.
why_zh: 同类工具只做删除，它却能智能保留语气并预览插入，避免误删关键上下文。
why_en: Unlike simple strippers, it preserves tone and previews insertion, so you don't lose critical context.
